INSERT INTO auth_rate_limits AS r (scope, key, window_start, count)
        VALUES ($1, $2, now(), 1)
        ON CONFLICT (scope, key) DO UPDATE SET
            count = CASE
                WHEN r.window_start <= now() - make_interval(secs => $3)
                THEN 1 ELSE r.count + 1 END,
            window_start = CASE
                WHEN r.window_start <= now() - make_interval(secs => $3)
                THEN now() ELSE r.window_start END
        RETURNING count
